title: Remove the unscoped Bash wildcard
why: Bash(*) in an allow list makes every other allow entry decorative and leaves the deny list as the only control still doing anything. It is usually added once to unblock a single command and then never narrowed, because nothing fails afterwards to remind you.
fix: Replace Bash or Bash(*) with the specific invocations you need, for example Bash(npm test) and Bash(git diff:*). Add the ones you actually hit over a week rather than guessing the set up front.
